name: Silver Shell Bastion
introDiscord: Interlocked silver shells form an old Moonkeeper bastion across the reef route. Watchful carvings turn toward you, sealed gates click open and closed by themselves, and something armored is already counting your footsteps.
introTwitch: Interlocked silver shells form an old Moonkeeper bastion across the reef route. Watchful carvings turn toward you, sealed gates click open and closed by themselves, and something armored is already counting your footsteps.

argent-causeway.prompt: A fortified causeway crosses toward three approaches. Silver shell plates line the walls, each engraved with an eye that seems much too interested in where you're standing.

left.message: Shizuki's field kit is hidden behind a loose plate. "Sentry-salve. Quiet feet are healthier feet. Loud feet discovered this medicine."
left.fullHpMessage: The Sentry-salve remains behind the loose plate. You are already at full health, and your footsteps have attracted enough attention.

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache sits behind a security grille that repeatedly closes one second before you reach it. Timing the mechanism earns you Star Candies and unreasonable satisfaction.

forward.message: A Silver Shell Sentry steps from an alcove, scans you from head to toe, and produces a deeply disapproving metallic click. Apparently your authorization is 'absolutely not.'

sentry-rampart.prompt: Shell ramparts rise through the water beneath rows of watchful carvings. Old warning bells sway overhead while three passages lead farther into the fortification.

left.message: A Sentry marches past without noticing you. You move. It stops. You stop. It resumes. You move again. It slowly turns around. Stealth negotiations have ended.

right.message: Shizuki's cache reads: "Drink now. The silver shells count footsteps. I tested this. They also count running footsteps faster."
right.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's cache remains unopened. At full health, there is no reason to let the silver shells count one more stop.

forward.message: A moon-shell coffer is sitting inside what was clearly once a confiscated-items locker. Among several ancient spoons and one sandal are Star Candies.

moonplate-keep.prompt: Moonplate walls enclose the inner keep. Three gates stand perfectly still, each beneath a different faded security symbol. One has 'NOPE' scratched beneath it in Shizuki's handwriting.

left.message: A Fae vessel has been confiscated and tagged with an ancient citation. Whatever crime it committed, its sentence has lasted long enough. You liberate Star Candies.

right.message: A Silver Shell Sentry emerges carrying an enormous ring of old keys. None fit the gate behind it. This does not appear to have improved its mood.

forward.message: Shizuki sealed one Berry inside a lockpick pouch: "Reward for opening the wrong door correctly. Yes, that is a skill."

boss-antechamber.name: Castellan Watch
boss-antechamber.prompt: The keep opens into a command chamber where hundreds of silver shell plates form one enormous armored silhouette at the far end.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every gate in the Bastion locks at once.

Three warning bells ring.

The armored figure at Castellan Watch rises, and every Sentry in the adjoining halls immediately stands at attention.

Use /yes to challenge the Castellan or /no to leave before it files the world's oldest trespassing report.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every gate in the Bastion locks at once.

Three warning bells ring.

The armored figure at Castellan Watch rises, and every Sentry in the adjoining halls immediately stands at attention.

Use !yes to challenge the Castellan or !no to leave before it files the world's oldest trespassing report.
bossRetreatText: You retreat from Castellan Watch. The warning bells stop, but the Bastion's locks remain deeply suspicious of you.

boss.revealText: The armored silhouette separates into hundreds of interlocked plates as the Argent Shell Castellan advances from the watch!

completionText: The Argent Shell Castellan lowers its weapon. One by one, the Bastion's locks release. A final security plate flashes ACCESS: RELUCTANTLY GRANTED before another route opens.
